youtube_description:
When everything around you is shaking, should you just run? In Psalm 11, David is told to "flee like a bird to your mountain" (Psalm 11:1).

His answer: "In the LORD I take refuge." The LORD is in his holy temple, his throne is in heaven, and "his eyes see, his eyelids test the children of man" (Psalm 11:4). The Hebrew is af'appav (ahf-ahp-PAHV): his eyelids. Picture someone narrowing their eyes to look closely. Nothing gets past him.

Today's step: when fear says run, stop and look up first. Say it out loud: "In the LORD I take refuge."

Day 11 of the Psalms, one chapter a day. Follow @thebibleexplainedai so you don't miss Psalm 12.

Read it: Psalm 11:1-7
